author: HanochZhu
description: Local code graph and solution memory for coding agents. Surgical reads and recall over a project, via CLI and MCP.

localizations.description: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码图与方案记忆。通过 CLI 和 MCP 对项目做精确读取与召回。
localizations.name: codeagent-memory

name: codeagent-memory

prompts.name: explore_code
prompts.description: Look up a project question in memory, then read the code graph.

prompts.name: remember_solution
prompts.description: Store what was just learned as atomic fact memories linked in a knowledge graph.

arguments.name: summary
arguments.description: One-line English title for a single atomic fact.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: Full write-up for this single atomic fact.

resources.name: status
resources.description: Whether the code graph database exists, with file, symbol, and memory counts.

resources.name: memory-tree
resources.description: Solution memory tree for the resolved project.

tools.name: cam_index
tools.description: Parse the project with tree-sitter into .cam/cam.db. Equivalent CLI: cam index

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

tools.name: cam_ls
tools.description: List indexed directories, files, or symbols as a virtual filesystem. Directories that are git checkouts of their own are listed with kind `project`; pass such a path as `scope` to cam_ref in multi-repo workspaces. Needs an indexed graph; call cam_index first if it reports the graph is not indexed. Equivalent CLI: cam ls [virt_path]

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

virt_path.description: Virtual path such as src/ or src/main.rs. Omit for repo root.

tools.name: cam_read
tools.description: Read a file outline or a symbol body. Prefer symbol paths (src/main.rs/main) over --full. If the name occurs more than once in the file the result has status `ambiguous` with `candidates`; re-call with a candidate `id` as virt_path. Needs an indexed graph; call cam_index first if it reports the graph is not indexed. Equivalent CLI: cam read <virt_path> [--full]

full.description: Read the whole file instead of the outline.

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

virt_path.description: File (src/main.rs), symbol (src/main.rs/main), or a node id from an ambiguous answer.

tools.name: cam_ref
tools.description: One-hop callers (in) or callees (out). A bare name that matches several definitions returns status `ambiguous` with ranked `candidates` instead of refs; re-call with a candidate `id` as symbol, or narrow with `file` / `kind` / `scope`. Needs an indexed graph; call cam_index first if it reports the graph is not indexed. Equivalent CLI: cam ref <symbol> --dir in|out [--file SUBSTR] [--kind KIND] [--scope DIR]

file.description: Disambiguate: case-insensitive substring of the defining file path, e.g. core/src/config.ts.

kind.description: Disambiguate: node kind (function, method, struct, class, trait, enum, enum_variant, type_alias).

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

scope.description: Restrict resolution and refs to this sub-directory, typically a `project` entry from cam_ls (e.g. codely-cli).

symbol.description: Symbol name, node id, or virtual path like src/lib.rs/add.

tools.name: cam_recall
tools.description: Hybrid recall (vector + BM25 fused with RRF), scaled slightly by Ebbinghaus retention. The query must be written in English. `score` near 2 means both paths matched, near 1 only one. Every hit carries its full body unless `snippets` is set; then long bodies below the top hit come back clipped with `body_truncated: true`, and cam_mem_show returns the full text. By default it pulls in the newest revision and hides superseded revisions. A successful returned match refreshes retention. Equivalent CLI: cam recall "<query>" [--limit N] [--no-expand] [--include-superseded] [--snippets]

expand.description: Pull in the newest revision of each match, even when it matches neither path. Set false to score the raw fused list.

hash_embed.description: Use the test hash embedder instead of model2vec.

include_superseded.description: Return older revisions as well as the latest one for history or comparison queries.

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

query.description: One-sentence question written in English. Non-Latin scripts are rejected.

snippets.description: Clip long bodies below the top hit to snippets marked body_truncated; read one in full with cam_mem_show.

tools.name: cam_add
tools.description: Store one atomic fact as a memory with its summary written in English (avoid packing multiple facts into a single memory). Non-Latin scripts in summary are rejected; the body supports non-Latin characters. When multiple facts are related, pass their IDs in `links` to connect them in the knowledge graph. Use parent for structural hierarchy and supersedes only when this complete memory replaces an older revision. Equivalent CLI: cam add --summary "..." [--parent ID] [--supersedes ID] [--link ID]... --body "..." (or --file / stdin)

body.description: Full write-up for this single atomic fact. Supports non-Latin characters. Required.

hash_embed.description: Use the test hash embedder instead of model2vec.

links.description: Related memory IDs to link to this fact in the knowledge graph.

parent.description: Structural parent memory id. This relation may branch and does not affect latest.

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

summary.description: One-line English title for a single atomic fact. Must be written in English.

supersedes.description: Older revision replaced by this complete current memory. Omit for a structural child or independent memory.

tools.name: cam_mem_tree
tools.description: Print the solution tree. Equivalent CLI: cam mem tree

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.

tools.name: cam_mem_show
tools.description: Show one memory by id. Equivalent CLI: cam mem show <id>

id.description: Solution id from recall or cam_mem_tree.

path.description: Project root. Defaults to CAM_PROJECT, then the server --project, then .cam / .git walk-up from the server cwd, else the server cwd.
